assertions.source: Sanity invariant: this probe documents Hyp-C's status as UNDERSPECIFIED and lists the refinement needed (knot + convention choice). Open follow-up.

description: Hyp-C scoping: tests whether the Kauffman-bracket interpretation of rung 2 = hbar_q^3/[2]_q is self-consistent.  Performs the classical-limit cross-check (rung 2 vanishes at q=1, so any Kauffman-bracket-derived expression must vanish at the same order).  Identifies which specific Kauffman-bracket reading would be testable.

classical_limit_test.note: Order-h^3 extraction trivially gives vanishing-at-q=1, so the test does NOT discriminate without specifying the knot.
